---
title: "How-to Guides"
---

How-to guides are goal-oriented recipes. They answer a specific question that an existing user can already formulate.

## Add How-to Guides Here

Use this section for task-focused guides such as:

- How to set up local development.
- How to run tests and quality checks.
- How to add, deploy, migrate, inspect, or troubleshoot a project capability.

Keep each guide focused on the practical outcome. Link to [Explanation](./explanation.qmd) when background context would interrupt the recipe.
